//: Canonical research-governor grant shape (same as V141). Accepted by the owner in V372 (2026-11-22): 'J'accepte le principe du grant V371 et autorise son activation après vérification technique'. The V371 grant text itself was never supplied to this repository; this file materializes the V372 conditions verbatim-in-substance. V141 is EXPIRED and is NOT reused.

grant.issuedBy: owner (CTO V372 §3 — explicit acceptance of the V371 grant principle + activation after technical verification)
grant.scope: READ_ONLY_PUBLIC_RESEARCH — public, unauthenticated, official/scientific sources; knowledge integration into ODG canonical memory
grant.allowedDomainsNote: initial allowlist = the owner-cited starting sources (sma.nasa.gov is covered as a subdomain of nasa.gov). V372 authorizes ADDING public domains when legitimacy, utility and safety are verified: every addition must be a new versioned commit with a justification line in domainAdditions[] (never a silent widening).

enforcement.policy: runtime/core/research-governor.ts govern() — authorized + unexpired + domain allowlist (deny-by-default)
enforcement.transport: runtime/core/bounded-http-client.ts — HTTPS-only, host allowlist, no userinfo, SSRF guard (localhost/RFC1918/link-local/IP-literal/metadata), timeout, size cap, bounded redirects, content-type check
enforcement.content: runtime/core/frontier-radar.ts sanitizeExternal() — external text is DATA, prompt-injection ⇒ QUARANTINE
enforcement.provenance+dedup: runtime/core/research-governor.ts stampFinding() (dated source, anti-fabrication) + odg-knowledge-acquisition (claim dedup + corroboration ≥2 independent sources)

constraints: no private credentials, no authentication, no account creation
no external writes, no form submission, no side effect on any third party
no paid API, no purchase, no subscription
no circumvention of access controls (HTTP 401/403/429 recorded, never bypassed); respect robots/terms
no secret transmitted in any request
reuse recorded results before any new collection
